Furthermore, any two solutions of the system are congruent modulo $n_1 n_2 \cdots n_k$.

  have h_main : ∀ (p q : ℝ), p ∈ Icc a b → q ∈ Icc a b → f p = 0 → f q = 0 → p = q := by
    intro p q hp hq hfp hfq
    by_contra hpq
    have h₁ : p ≠ q := hpq
    have h₂ : p < q ∨ q < p := by
      cases' lt_or_gt_of_ne h₁ with h h
      · exact Or.inl h
      · exact Or.inr h
    cases' h₂ with h₂ h₂
    · -- Case p < q
      have h₃ : ContinuousOn f (Icc p q) := by
        apply ContinuousOn.mono hf
        intro x hx
        exact ⟨le_trans (by linarith [hp.1, hp.2]) hx.1, le_trans hx.2 (by linarith [hq.1, hq.2])⟩
      have h₄ : DifferentiableOn ℝ f (Ioo p q) := by
        intro x hx
        have h₅ : x ∈ Ioo a b := by
          constructor <;> linarith [hp.1, hp.2, hq.1, hq.2, hx.1, hx.2]
        exact (hderiv x h₅).differentiableWithinAt
      have h₅ : ∃ c ∈ Ioo p q, deriv f c = (f q - f p) / (q - p) := by
        apply exists_deriv_eq_slope f _ _

        <;> linarith [hp.1, hp.2, hq.1, hq.2]

        <;> ring_nf
        <;> simp_all
        <;> linarith
      have h₇ : deriv f c ≠ 0 := by
        have h₈ : c ∈ Ioo a b := by
          have h₉ : a < c := by linarith [hc.1]
          have h₁₀ : c < b := by linarith [hc.2]
          exact ⟨h₉, h₁₀⟩
        exact hnonzero c h₈
      exact h₇ h₆
    · -- Case q < p

        apply ContinuousOn.mono hf
        intro x hx
        exact ⟨le_trans (by linarith [hq.1, hq.2]) hx.1, le_trans hx.2 (by linarith [hp.1, hp.2])⟩
      have h₄ : DifferentiableOn ℝ f (Ioo q p) := by
        intro x hx
        have h₅ : x ∈ Ioo a b := by
          constructor <;> linarith [hq.1, hq.2, hp.1, hp.2, hx.1, hx.2]
        exact (hderiv x h₅).differentiableWithinAt
      have h₅ : ∃ c ∈ Ioo q p, deriv f c = (f p - f q) / (p - q) := by
        apply exists_deriv_eq_slope f _ _
        <;> simp_all [h₂]
        <;> linarith [hp.1, hp.2, hq.1, hq.2]

      have h₆ : deriv f c = 0 := by

        <;> field_simp [sub_ne_zero.mpr h₁, sub_ne_zero.mpr h₁.symm]
        <;> ring_nf
